Background

About Me

I am a Project Lead at MT Hojgaard Vietnam with over 9 years of experience spanning on-site construction supervision, structural BIM modelling, rebar shop drawing production, and prefabricated timber element design and production.

My career has been a deliberate progression from structural supervisor on-site, to BIM Engineer, to leading full project delivery for Danish engineering and construction firms. I hold a PMP certification and apply structured project management practices across every engagement.

Before joining MT Højgaard Vietnam, I worked for one of the top local construction firms (Hoa Binh Construction Group), where I was responsible for concrete construction modelling and led the rebar shop drawing team for residential and high-rise projects.

My primary delivery market is Denmark, coordinating structural BIM models with Scandinavian clients and design teams, while managing cross-functional teams of up to 10 from Ho Chi Minh City.

Culture & People

Team & Environment

Building High-Performing Teams

At MT Hojgaard Vietnam, I lead the project BIM team, delivering structural models for Danish clients across multiple concurrent projects.

My focus is not just on deliverables it is on developing people. I invest in capacity building, provide technical mentorship, and create an environment where each team member's expertise is valued and recognised.

Working across cultures has shaped a transparent approach focused on stakeholder management, efficient communication, and connecting people.
